exclusion_reason: Clean unfixed/fixed builds did not show the required performance difference on the declared workload during screening (median ratio 0.998).
bug_description: WebPage.onTitleReceive serializes the ENTIRE browsing-history list with JSON.stringify(list.map(...)) twice (before and after every recorded page visit), and HistoryPage.aboutToAppear stringifies the whole list again when the history page opens. With a large history this materializes and stringifies hundreds of entries on every page-load title event, blocking the web page load path and the history page transition.
fix_summary: The debug logs report the list size only, removing full-list map + JSON.stringify on the page-load and page-open paths.

test_oracle.definition: Native app on-CPU sched_switch intervals clipped to external native-clock markers around five complete normal history page loads; not wall time or app counters.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
